summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing an at-the-market sales agreement dated October 9, 2026 with Arc Group Securities LLC as sales agent, allowing it to offer up to $96,399,000 of Class A ordinary shares under its Form F-3 shelf (filed July 9, 2025; effective September 2, 2025), supplemented October 9, 2026. Agent compensation is 2.5% of gross proceeds plus up to $100,000 expense reimbursement. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions and expansion, though no such commitments exist. This is an ordinary shelf takedown mechanism, not a special situation.
